import re, urllib.request
BASE = "http://160.202.254.160:15880/"
PROXY = {"http": "http://127.0.0.1:12001", "https": "http://127.0.0.1:12001"}
op = urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.ProxyHandler(PROXY))

with op.open(BASE + "index.php", timeout=20) as r:
    body = r.read().decode("gb18030", "replace")
print("len =", len(body))
print("=== 前 1800 字符 ===")
print(body[:1800])
print("=== 后 1200 字符 ===")
print(body[-1200:])
print("=== 是否含 flag/cookie/admin 关键字 ===")
for kw in ["flag", "cookie", "admin", "document", "script"]:
    print("  %-10s %s" % (kw, kw.lower() in body.lower()))
